title: StockSmart Training Questions — Next-Day-Air Bookings and Reorder Allowance on a Consigned Bin
content:
**Rule.** For the reorder point of a new consigned StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program bin that takes over an item taken out of one of the customer's VendPoint machines, next-day-air bookings of the transferred item at the program's ship-to in the last six months add allowance days: 2 or more add 1 day, exactly 1 adds 0.5 day, and none adds none.

**Q. Where are the bookings read?** On the order lines booked for the item at the program's ship-to, held as a Ship-To Fulfillment Account, with next day air as the ship method.

**Q. What are the last six months?** Rows of age below six, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month.

**Q. Hypothetically, 4 such bookings?** 1 day, the same as 2.

**Q. Exactly 1?** 0.5 day. **None?** Nothing is added.

**Q. Do next-day-air bookings at another ship-to of the same customer count?** No; only bookings at the program's own ship-to.
